method: R1 blind suread (subagent read text only, no md/rules)

facts.fact: Julian 给 Hattie 朗读书中的一章，她听着孙子的声音，感觉是自 Ross Eeling 上门讹诈以来最好的时刻。
facts.anchor: Julian reads a chapter to her out loud

facts.fact: 大约八点 Kevin 发短信说十五分钟后到家，并问是否要顺路接 Julian，Hattie 说她会走过去送。
facts.anchor: Around eight Kevin texts saying he’ll be home in fifteen

facts.fact: Hattie 送 Julian 回家，走到一半 Julian 握住她的手，一直牵到前门才松开。
facts.anchor: Julian takes her hand halfway to his house, not letting go until they’re at the front door

facts.fact: Kevin 在门廊拥抱儿子 Julian，问他和 Mary 玩得是否开心、有没有完成阅读。
facts.anchor: “Hey, buddy,” Kevin says, hugging his son briefly in the entryway

facts.fact: Hattie 提起霸凌者今天又回学校，Kevin 说他们收到邮件，校长认定停学三天就够了。
facts.anchor: The principal decided three days’ suspension was enough

facts.fact: Hattie 提醒 Kevin，如果那两个孩子不分开，她担心会出事。
facts.anchor: I’m worried something might happen if the two of them aren’t kept apart

facts.fact: Hattie 压低声音告诉 Kevin，Julian 有时会伤害自己，并问他有没有注意到瘀伤、Wendy 是否提过做心理治疗。
facts.anchor: hurts himself sometimes. Maybe you’ve noticed some bruises?

facts.fact: Kevin 沉下脸回绝，说他们是 Julian 的父母、会决定什么对他最好，随后进门并关上门。
facts.anchor: We appreciate you helping us out from time to time, but we’re his parents, okay?

facts.fact: Hattie 独自在黑暗中看到有人站在猫头鹰树旁盯着她，手电筒从手中滑落。
facts.anchor: Someone is standing beside the owl tree watching her.
